description: Acoustic guitar classes for complete beginners.
details: Join Alex Martin in this foundational course designed for absolute beginners. You'll learn essential chords, basic strumming patterns, and how to read tablature. No prior musical experience is required, just bring your acoustic guitar and a passion for learning music.

description: Conversational English sessions for non-native speakers.
details: Boost your confidence with Sara Hossain's interactive sessions. This skill swap focuses on practical, real-world conversations, helping you improve fluency, pronunciation, and vocabulary. We'll discuss everyday topics in a supportive and friendly environment, perfect for intermediate learners looking to speak more naturally.

description: Learn the basics of Python programming in 4 weeks.
details: Dive into one of the world's most popular programming languages with Mike Chen. This 4-week workshop covers fundamental concepts like variables, data types, loops, and functions. You'll work on small projects to solidify your understanding and build a solid foundation for future coding endeavors.

description: Hands-on class: learn to make fresh pasta from scratch.
details: Discover the joy of authentic Italian cooking with Maria Rossi. In this hands-on session, you'll learn the secrets to making perfect pasta dough from scratch. We will explore different shapes, like fettuccine and ravioli, and prepare a simple, delicious sauce to accompany your creation.

description: Explore watercolor techniques, color mixing, and composition.
details: Unleash your inner artist with David Lee's beginner-friendly watercolor class. This session covers the essentials, from understanding your brushes and paper to mastering wet-on-wet and dry-brush techniques. You'll also learn the fundamentals of color theory and composition to create your own beautiful piece.

description: Start your day with an energizing Vinyasa flow session.
details: Awaken your body and mind with Priya Sharma's Morning Yoga Flow. This Vinyasa session links breath to movement, building heat, flexibility, and strength. It's the perfect way to energize your morning, reduce stress, and set a positive tone for the rest of your day.

description: Understand SEO, SEM, and social media marketing fundamentals.
details: Navigate the digital landscape with Kenji Tanaka. This essentials course breaks down the core components of online marketing. You'll gain a clear understanding of Search Engine Optimization (SEO), paid advertising (SEM), and how to leverage social media platforms to build a brand and engage audiences.

description: Learn the basics of centering clay and throwing simple forms.
details: Get your hands dirty with Emily Clark and experience the therapeutic art of pottery. This introductory class focuses on the potter's wheel, guiding you through the essential techniques of centering the clay, pulling walls, and shaping basic forms like bowls and cylinders. No experience necessary.

description: Practice your Spanish speaking skills in a relaxed group.
details: ¡Hola! Join Javier Gomez for a casual and immersive Spanish conversation group. This session is not a formal lesson, but a chance to practice speaking and listening in a relaxed setting. We'll chat about culture, travel, and daily life to help build your confidence.

description: Build dynamic user interfaces with the React library.
details: Start your front-end development journey with Ben Carter. This beginner's guide to ReactJS will teach you how to build modern, component-based web applications. You'll learn about JSX, state, props, and hooks, and by the end, you'll build your very own small interactive app.

description: Get feedback on your stories and learn narrative techniques.
details: Find your voice with Olivia Brown's creative writing workshop. This is a supportive space to share your work, whether it's fiction, poetry, or non-fiction. We will focus on key narrative elements like character development, plot structure, and dialogue, providing constructive feedback to elevate your writing.

description: Understand scales, chords, and harmony. No instrument needed.
details: Demystify the language of music with Alex Martin. This course covers the fundamental building blocks of music theory, including scales, intervals, key signatures, and chord construction. It's perfect for musicians who want to understand *why* music works, or for any curious music lover.
